title: 侧边栏
summary: 靠左只是外观。先定占不占位，展开改的是宽度还是图层。
summaryEn: Flush-left is only the look. First decide whether it occupies space, and whether expand changes width or layer.
asks: 靠左那一块占不占位、怎么让路？
asksEn: Does this left-hand thing occupy space, and how does it yield?
